biggest_catch: Both you and your friend must become active Pronto Power customers for the $20 credit to materialize, and the program is advertised across city pages without a stated expiration, so confirm it is still active with Pronto Power before counting on it.
catches: The referred friend must become a Pronto Power customer and tell Pronto Power they were referred by you.
The $20 credit is applied to the electricity account, not paid in cash.
Pronto Power is a prepaid, no-contract service with its own rate structure - compare plan rates before switching.
The only signup out-of-pocket cost is the $20 account preload (yours to spend on usage, not a fee).

c1.evidence: Official supplier-owned domain (powermepronto.com); program described consistently across multiple official pages.

c2.evidence: Terms described on official pages; Summer Energy dba Pronto Power, PUCT Certificate No. 10205, per official Terms of Service PDF on the same domain.

c3.evidence: Incentive framed as savings on planned energy spending ($20 bill credit), never income.

c4.evidence: Distinct supplier and mechanism; no existing evidence for Pronto Power / Summer Energy (dedupe returned zero hits).

eligibility: Pronto Power customers who refer friends; referred friend must become a Pronto Power customer and name the referrer.
notes: Referral credits framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income. Program appears on multiple official city pages with no stated expiration.
numeric_basis: payout $20 per side from official page text ('we will credit you and your friend $20'); time: 5-15 minutes for referral sharing
payout_quote: For every new customer you refer to Pronto Power, we will credit you and your friend $20 on both your accounts. Every time one of your friends becomes a customer and tells us you referred him or her, you will see another $20 credit on your bill.
payout_value_note: $20 bill credit to both the referrer and the referred friend for each successful referral; no cap stated on the official pages.

s1.note: You are a Pronto Power customer with an active account.

s2.note: Share Pronto Power with a friend or family member.

s3.note: Your friend signs up as a new Pronto Power customer and tells Pronto Power you referred them.

s4.note: Both accounts receive a $20 credit on that month's bill; no cap stated, each referral adds another credit.

s5.note: Credit posts to the bill once the referred friend becomes a customer; no waiting period stated.

s6.note: No direct cash payout; credit applies to the Pronto Power prepaid account balance.

s7.note: Texas service areas where Pronto Power offers prepaid electricity.

steps: Sign up as a Pronto Power customer (prepaid, no deposit, no contract; $20 account preload is yours to spend on usage).
Tell friends or family to sign up with Pronto Power.
Have each referred friend tell Pronto Power at signup that you referred them.
Collect a $20 credit on your bill for each referral; your friend also receives $20.
timing: Sharing a referral takes 5-15 minutes of active effort; the $20 credits appear on the bill once the friend signs up.
